scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.build:tool: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:auth: cd auth && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:all: npm run build:tool && npm run build:auth && cd cloudflare-backend && npm install
scripts.deploy:tool: cd frontend && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=agentflow-hackathon
scripts.deploy:auth: cd auth && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=agentflow-auth
scripts.deploy:all: npm run deploy:auth && npm run deploy:tool && npm run deploy:landing
